name: hk_vor_smallest
requirements: Station with smallest Voronoi cell + area. Store smallest_cell_station (str) and smallest_cell_km2 (float,1dp).

turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Which station has the SMALLEST Voronoi cell, and what is its area (km², 1 dp)? Return the station name and area.
